cos(2 pi (hour + minute / 60) / 24).
sin(heading in radians): the east component of the direction of travel, with heading_cos (the north component), so that 359 degrees lies next to 1 degree.
cos(heading in radians).

description: Trip the point belongs to, by the rule TRIP_RULE (see processed/trips, column rule). Local date of the trip start. Under stop_gap, a trip's first and last points are the last point of the stop before and the first point of the stop after, so they also have a stop_id.
